ch_b45d52f9c228f:1.before: After a retryable response (429 or other 5xx), the loop waits a random backoff and retries without consulting Retry-After.
ch_b45d52f9c228f:1.after: Before the random backoff, the code reads the Retry-After header and, if present, waits that many seconds converted to milliseconds before retrying.

chapters.title: Signature verification with mismatch logging
chapters.summary: Adds a verify function that signs the body and compares it to the given signature. When they differ, it logs the secret, the received signature, and the expected signature before returning false.

ch_67bfc410f56c0:1.before: Webhook deliveries are sent as POST requests with only a content-type header, so receivers cannot confirm a delivery came from Relay.
ch_67bfc410f56c0:1.after: Every delivery now includes an x-relay-signature header containing an HMAC-SHA256 hex digest of the exact request body, computed with a secret passed to deliver.

chapters.title: HMAC signing helper
chapters.summary: A new function signs a body with HMAC-SHA256 using a secret and returns the digest as a lowercase hex string.

chapters.title: Signing wired into delivery
chapters.summary: The deliver function takes a new secret parameter and adds the x-relay-signature header to each POST attempt.

chapters.title: Changelog entry
chapters.summary: The changelog notes that webhook payloads are now signed.

ch_3a295c41c1795:1.before: Refund amounts were truncated with Math.floor, so any fractional cents were dropped and partial refunds could lose a cent.
ch_3a295c41c1795:1.after: Refund amounts are rounded with Math.round, so fractional cents round half-up instead of always rounding down.

chapters.title: Refund rounding behavior
chapters.summary: The refund helper now rounds half-up instead of truncating fractional cents.

ch_72e6482850412:1.before: The repository's Braid instructions contain two rules: never log webhook secrets in src/**, and no em dashes in UI copy under public/**. There is no rule about retry behavior.
ch_72e6482850412:1.after: A third Braid instruction is added: retries must back off and never retry 4xx responses except 429, applying to src/**. The rule is recorded in .braid/instructions.json and mirrored in the Braid section of AGENTS.md.

chapters.title: New retry instruction in Braid config
chapters.summary: Adds an instruction entry with id retries-back-off-never-retry-4xx, scoped to src/**, to the instructions array.

chapters.title: Documented in AGENTS.md
chapters.summary: Adds a matching bullet to the Braid instructions section of AGENTS.md stating the retry rule and its src/** scope.

ch_9b38e6ea37074:1.before: The delivery POST request has no timeout and waits indefinitely for a slow receiver to respond.
ch_9b38e6ea37074:1.after: The delivery POST request aborts after 10 seconds, so a slow receiver no longer keeps the request open indefinitely.

chapters.title: Abort delivery fetch after ten seconds
chapters.summary: The fetch call now passes AbortSignal.timeout(10_000), aborting the request after 10 seconds.

ch_fa982ca936600:1.before: The Relay worker only accepts POST requests; any GET request falls through to a plain-text response, so load balancers cannot cheaply check service health.
ch_fa982ca936600:1.after: A GET request to /health returns a JSON body { ok: true } before any method check, while all other requests behave as before.

chapters.title: Health route in the worker
chapters.summary: The fetch handler checks for a /health path first and returns a JSON ok response.

chapters.title: Changelog entry
chapters.summary: The changelog records the new health route.

ch_a9b7fdd7ef33f:1.before: The repository has no documentation for teams receiving Relay webhooks; the README only describes delivery from the sender's side.
ch_a9b7fdd7ef33f:1.after: A new guide documents how receivers should verify signatures and handle repeated deliveries, and the README links to it.

chapters.title: Receiver contract guide
chapters.summary: Adds a short guide telling receivers to verify the x-relay-signature header with HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body, drop duplicates using idempotency-key, and respond with 2xx within ten seconds.

chapters.title: README link to the guide
chapters.summary: Adds a Receivers section to the README pointing teams to the new receiver contract guide.

ch_53515625f4c94:1.before: A failed delivery is reported after a single fetch attempt, with attempts always set to 1.
ch_53515625f4c94:1.after: A delivery is retried up to three times with jittered exponential backoff when the fetch throws or the response is a 5xx or 429; other client errors and successes return immediately.

chapters.title: Retry loop in delivery
chapters.summary: The delivery function now loops up to three attempts. Network errors and 5xx or 429 responses trigger a backoff wait; other responses return immediately.

chapters.title: Changelog entry
chapters.summary: Adds a changelog line describing the retry behavior.
